name: lint
title: dfdl lint
author: Dylan Fernandez de Lara
description: The design-system lint policy: no raw colors, no arbitrary values, no inline styles, and per-component contracts. Spread eslint.dfdl.mjs into your ESLint config.

files.content:
{
  "$comment": "dfdl design-system lint policy. Mechanical rules live here; judgment lives in the skill. Consumers extend this file. Contracts: controls keep the height scale (24/28/32/40/48); pick a size instead of setting a height. Margins on the dfdl rhythm (m*-minor, m*-major) are allowed by name: @shadcn/lint 0.2.0 reads custom color names from the theme but not custom spacing names, so without them it calls mt-minor unrecognized.",
  "rules": {
    "shadcn/no-raw-colors": [
      "error",
      {
        "message": "Use a dfdl semantic color (bg-surface, text-fg-secondary, border-line, bg-accent-solid, ...) from {{file}}. Primitives and Tailwind palette colors are not allowed in components."
      }
    ],
    "shadcn/no-arbitrary-values": [
      "error",
      {
        "message": "Stay on the dfdl scale. Spacing is multiples of 8 (minor) and 24 (major); radii are rounded-xs/sm/md/lg/xl/full; add a token if a value is genuinely missing."
      }
    ],
    "shadcn/no-inline-styles": "error",
    "shadcn/no-restyle": [
      "error",
      {
        "allow": [
          "layout",
          "m*-minor",
          "m*-major",
          "-m*-minor",
          "-m*-major"
        ],
        "message": {
          "spacing": "{{component}} owns its padding. Use a size ({{sizes}}) or put margin/gap on the parent.",
          "typography": "{{component}} owns its type. Pick a variant or size instead of overriding font classes.",
          "color": "{{component}} owns its color. Use a variant; add one in the component only if the design calls for it."
        },
        "contracts": [
          {
            "pattern": "^Button$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^Input$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(SegmentedControl|SegmentedControlItem)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^Switch$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*",
              "w-*",
              "min-w-*",
              "max-w-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^TabsTab$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(MenuItem|MenuLabel)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(Badge|Kbd)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^TabsList$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^Avatar$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*",
              "w-*"
            ]
          },
          {
            "pattern": "^(ComboboxInput|CollapsibleTrigger)$",
            "allow": [
              "layout",
              "m*-minor",
              "m*-major",
              "-m*-minor",
              "-m*-major"
            ],
            "deny": [
              "h-*",
              "min-h-*",
              "max-h-*",
              "size-*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "overrides": [
    {
      "files": [
        "**/components/ui/**"
      ],
      "rules": {
        "shadcn/no-restyle": "off"
      }
    }
  ]
}

/*
  dfdl design-system lint for an ESLint flat config. Installed by the `lint` registry item; dfdl-ui uses it too.

    import dfdl from "./eslint.dfdl.mjs"
    export default defineConfig([...yourConfig, ...dfdl])

  Rules and per-component contracts live in design-system.lint.json. Components under components/ui restyle their
  own parts, so the restyle rule is off there.
*/
import { plugin as shadcn } from "@shadcn/lint"

import policy from "./design-system.lint.json" with { type: "json" }

const dfdl = [{ files: ["**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}"], plugins: { shadcn }, rules: policy.rules }, ...policy.overrides]

export default dfdl

docs: Add to eslint.config.mjs: import dfdl from "./eslint.dfdl.mjs" and spread ...dfdl into defineConfig after your own config. Then npm run lint; each error says what to use instead.
